Pulling her way onto *The Strix*, Secel couldn't do anything but cry. She rolled over, her eyes looking at the ceiling. She felt... pain. Pain ripping at her heart. Pain causing her to want to rip it out and throw it off the dock just to no longer feel the pain. The connection she thought they shared... nothing but her own imaginings. Nothing but a fantasy she had worked up in her own head to fill a void she didn't know existed.

Trying to stand up, she took a few steps before falling again. She felt too weak to stand, too weak to even get up. Her love for him... a love she thought he shared with her... faded in her heart. Not all the way, but... well, it was close. She tried to get up once again.

Again, she only made it a few steps. This time she screamed. She screamed out a tortured yell of loss, a yell of hatred at love and all it represented, a yell of damnation of the feelings that followed love. She pushed herself up once more, and staggered forward...

Before collapsing again. This time, she landed full on her face. She clutched at her head, new tears from this pain trickling from her eyes. She felt like... like nothing mattered anymore. That her whole world was lost. She wondered how everything couldn't see that the world was ending. She couldn't understand how life went on like it does. She didn't even bother standing. 

Soon she dragged herself into her room. She tried to pull herself up, fighting with her failing body to pull herself into the comforting familiarity of her bed... but she couldn't. Now, more than ever, she wanted him. She wanted to be in his arms. She wanted to be close to him. She wanted...

She wanted to kiss him. She wanted a feeling of love with him that was shared. She wanted something... she realized might never happen. Those images of waking up with him, his arms around her and planting a loving kiss on her cheek, rays of sunshine making him even more like everything she wanted.. those images of them by a fire on a cold winter's 
-

night, bundled tightly in a blanket, drinking warm drinks late into the night, only to fall asleep.. those images of walking in meadows, a warm sun lighting the landscape, birds singing love songs as they passed by, setting the mood for him to spin her around and pull her in close.. Everything she wanted.... now no longer an option.

She curled up, quietly humming to herself. She hummed a sad song. A song about the end of the world.. Her world.. because he didn’t love her, because he didn’t care about her, because he said goodbye. In truth, he does love her, he does care about her, and he hadn’t said goodbye to her. But she didn’t know that. She only knew she had loved him when they first met. She didn’t know he did as well. She only knew her feelings had grown for him. She didn’t know his own feelings had grown for her. She, like him, didn’t know what the feeling was at first… but now, they did. But, only she knew about her own feelings.

She didn’t know that he did love her, and wanted to keep her safe, just like everyone who lives in Empire City. But.. even now, she didn’t even think he was capable of such feelings. She thought he was so devoted to Athena that… that… that he didn’t see what she saw. She then slammed her head against her bed frame, cursing herself for blaming Athena for her own failures, for her own issues, for her own wants and desires… for her own sins. But, this was simply her being young, full of life and love, and wanting someone to share it with… 

But, now… now she would never get that chance. She believed she had blown her one chance at having a life she so desperately wanted. She thought she had squandered away her only chance at happiness with someone she truly cared for. The only person outside of her family she had ever had love her like she loves them. Someone she wanted to live out her days with, to grow old and grey with, to walk into the Heavens with, hand and hand, to Athena’s side to live forever more. Someone… she would love 
-
